What's Special this year?

The upcoming Maha Purnima (Guru Purnima) will feature a special and rare offering known as the Guru Kripa Sankalp (Guru’s Grace Resolve). This is highlighted as a unique opportunity, occurring only once a year, unlike other regular Hawans or festivals.
What is the Guru Kripa Sankalp?

The Guru Kripa Sankalp is specifically designed for the fulfillment of your heartfelt desire ( manvanchit ichha ). While typically, participants are not encouraged to express specific material wish during Hawans, this particular Sankalp is an exception due to its unique significance on Guru Purnima.
Conditions for Fulfillment of Desire:
The Guru has laid down three crucial conditions for a wish to be granted through this Sankalp:
Body engagement in chanting: Your physical self must be actively engaged in mantra chanting ( sharir mein mantra jaap hona chahiye ). This implies consistent and dedicated japa .
Favorable planetary alignment: There needs to be at least a slight favorable planetary alignment in your astrological chart ( graho mein thoda sa yog hona chahiye ).

Feasibility of the wish: The desire itself must be something that is inherently possible to achieve ( woh karya sambhav hone ki ichha honi chahiye ). It is strongly advised against asking for unrealistic or impossible things, as doing so might even lead to the loss of what you already possess. The Guru will reveal what is not meant for you, guiding you to focus only on what is attainable.
If these three conditions are met, the fulfillment of your wish is guaranteed. However, it’s crucial to remember that only one wish will be granted through this specific Sankalp.

Fulfill a specific, heartfelt wish through divine grace.
Seek profound spiritual growth and a deeper connection with higher energies.

Enhance Spiritual Growth: Beneficial for both beginners and seasoned practitioners aiming to elevate their consciousness and unlock higher dimensions of energy.
Unlocking inner potential and developing subtle senses.

FAQ'S
1. What is the Guru Purnima Maha Hawan?

The Maha Hawan is scheduled only once in a year on the special occasion of guru purnima. Please check our registration page for the exact date, time, and details on how to participate online or at Ashaeiynn venue.
2. What are the benefits of participating in the Maha Hawan?
Aspirant who wants to full their heartfelt desires and increase their dev kripa, activate or increase their bhakti tatva, dimensions , mool tattva & astral world capabilities.
3. What are the different Hawan slabs offered during the event?
This year with the grace of gurudev, we are offering three specialized Havan slabs:
Guru Kripa Sankalp (₹4100): This Sankalp is specifically for fulfilling your desired wishes ( manvanchit ichha ).
Sankalp Raksha Suraksha (₹3100): Protection against all types of Negativities Tattva: Black Magic, Pitra etc.
Jagriti Sankalp (₹5100): Activates your spiritual potential, awakens advanced chakra layers, and boosts your mantra shakti.
4. How do I register for the event?

Registration is simple. Visit our website’s event page (Ashaeiynn.com/guru-purnima-maha-hawan), fill out the checkout page, choose the Havan slab that suits your needs, and complete the payment process. You will receive a confirmation email with further details. After that go to “Ashaeiynn App: – Then open Maha Hawan form and fill out the form so that your sankalp can be taken during Maha Hawan
5. Can I participate if I am new to spiritual practices?

Absolutely. The Maha Hawan is open to everyone, regardless of experience level. Our experienced facilitators will guide you through the process, ensuring that you receive the full benefits of this transformative ritual.
